newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma to meet Camdessus in Washington.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma to meet Camdessus in Washington.

text.p: President Leonid Kuchma will meet International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus in Washington on Thursday to review prospects for a multi-billion-dollar loan, an IMF official said.
"A meeting between President Kuchma and Michel Camdessus is scheduled for tomorrow," Patrick Lenain, the Fund's senior resident representative in Ukraine, told Reuters.

Lenain confirmed that the two men would discuss prospects for Ukraine reaching an agreement on an IMF-backed economic programme with a view to the former Soviet republic receiving a $2.5 to $3 billion Extended Fund Facility loan.
Ukraine has fulfilled about half of a list of 41 conditions for receipt of the loan but the key element, parliament's approval of this year's budget, has yet to materialise.

Kuchma's visit to the United States, starting on Wednesday, comes as a regular meeting with U.S. Vice-President Al Gore through the Kuchma-Gore Commission, set up in 1995 to deal with security, foreign policy, economy and investment.
